# Supported Build Artifact Types

This page is the explicit coverage list for 2048 Nova build outputs. It distinguishes artifacts that the repository currently builds/qualifies in CI, artifacts that the configured Flutter project can build locally with the required signing/toolchain, and packaging formats that are **not currently maintained project outputs**.

## Status meanings

- **CI-qualified build path** — the repository's permanent workflows currently build this type from relevant source changes.
- **Documented build path** — the configured project/toolchain supports building it, but it is not currently uploaded as the permanent qualification artifact.
- **Not currently maintained** — do not advertise this format as a supported 2048 Nova release artifact until implementation, CI, tests, and documentation are added.

## Android

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Debug APK | `.apk` | Documented build path | `flutter build apk --debug` |
| Profile APK | `.apk` | Documented build path | `flutter build apk --profile` |
| Universal release APK | `.apk` | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build apk --release` |
| ABI-split release APKs | `.apk` set | Documented build path | `flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi` |
| Release Android App Bundle | `.aab` | Documented build path | `flutter build appbundle --release` |

Important: the tracked Android release build type currently uses the debug signing configuration for public qualification. Production store signing remains separate.

## iOS

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unsigned release app bundle | `.app` directory bundle | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build ios --release --no-codesign` |
| Signed/exported IPA | `.ipa` | Documented build path when Apple signing/provisioning is configured | `flutter build ipa --release` |

The unsigned CI `.app` archive is not equivalent to a signed IPA.

## Web / PWA

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard release Web bundle | `build/web/` directory | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build web --release` |
| Debug Web bundle | `build/web/` directory | Documented build path | `flutter build web --debug` |
| Profile Web bundle | `build/web/` directory | Documented build path | `flutter build web --profile` |
| WebAssembly-oriented Web bundle | `build/web/` directory | Documented build path; not permanent CI qualification path | `flutter build web --wasm` |

Web output is a directory of deployable assets, not a single native executable.

## Windows

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Native Windows release bundle | `nova_2048.exe` + DLL/data/runtime files | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build windows --release` |
| CI transfer archive | `.zip` + `.sha256` | **CI-qualified packaging path** | Repository PowerShell packaging in `platform-builds.yml` |

The `.exe` alone is not the complete distributable Flutter Windows application.

## macOS

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Native macOS app | `2048 Nova.app` | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build macos --release` |
| CI transfer archive | `.zip` + `.sha256` | **CI-qualified packaging path** | `ditto` + `shasum` in `platform-builds.yml` |

Production direct distribution signing/notarization or Mac App Store packaging remains separate from hosted compilation qualification.

## Linux

| Artifact | Extension/type | Status | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Native Linux release bundle | `nova_2048` ELF executable + `lib/` + `data/` | **CI-qualified build path** | `flutter build linux --release` |
| CI transfer archive | `.tar.gz` + `.sha256` | **CI-qualified packaging path** | Repository tar/sha256 commands in `platform-builds.yml` |

The ELF executable alone is not the complete Flutter Linux distribution bundle.

## Current CI qualification archive names

```text
nova-2048-android-release
  app-release.apk
  app-release.apk.sha256

nova-2048-linux-x64-release
  nova-2048-linux-x64.tar.gz
  nova-2048-linux-x64.tar.gz.sha256

nova-2048-windows-x64-release
  nova-2048-windows-x64.zip
  nova-2048-windows-x64.zip.sha256

nova-2048-macos-release
  nova-2048-macos-release.zip
  nova-2048-macos-release.zip.sha256

nova-2048-ios-unsigned-release
  nova-2048-ios-unsigned-release.zip
  nova-2048-ios-unsigned-release.zip.sha256
```

The standard Web release is built in permanent quality CI but is not currently uploaded by that workflow as a retained qualification archive.

## Not currently maintained project outputs

The following formats are **not currently configured as maintained 2048 Nova release outputs**:

### Windows

- MSI installer
- MSIX package
- Store package generated by a project-maintained packaging workflow
- third-party EXE installer

### macOS

- DMG image
- PKG installer
- notarized distribution archive produced by repository automation
- Mac App Store package produced by repository automation

### Linux

- `.deb`
- `.rpm`
- AppImage
- Snap
- Flatpak

### Android/iOS

- production-signed Android package produced by public repository CI
- production-signed iOS IPA produced by public repository CI

These may be added in the future, but only after the repository adds the required packaging/signing configuration, security handling, validation, and release documentation.

## Why unsupported formats are listed

Listing a format here as not maintained prevents build documentation from accidentally implying support simply because an ecosystem tool could theoretically create it.

A new format should be promoted to a documented/qualified status only when:

1. project configuration exists;
2. build instructions are reproducible;
3. required runtime files are packaged correctly;
4. secrets/signing are handled safely;
5. automated checks exist where practical;
6. representative real-target testing has been completed;
7. release qualification/documentation is updated.
